@@ -103,0 +105 @@ export function RecordCard({

@@ -124,6 +126,8 @@ export function RecordCard({
-  // The record has drawn once its own facts are on screen, or it could not
-  // be read (FI3-948): its body frame can start below the visible part of
-  // the card, where it reports nothing until it is scrolled to, so waiting
-  // on it kept the card at its first height. The frame then grows the card
-  // through the stage's size watcher, and still reports each later drawing.
-  const loaded = detail !== null || unreadable;
+  // The record is ready once its facts are loaded and its body frame has
+  // drawn, or it could not be read. The card stays unseen until then, so it
+  // appears at the height it keeps: revealing it on the facts alone drew an
+  // empty card that grew and re-centred twice as the facts and then the
+  // frame arrived (INF-510). The frame draws while the card is unseen; a
+  // frame that never reports ends on the stage's hold limit, and the card
+  // then appears as it is (FI3-948).
+  const loaded = (detail !== null && frameDrawn) || unreadable;

-              onDrawn,
+              onDrawn: () => setFrameDrawn(true),
diff --git a/src/renderer/src/cards/cardPresentation.ts b/src/renderer/src/cards/cardPresentation.ts
index f1a9d366..dbf7cff3 100644
--- a/src/renderer/src/cards/cardPresentation.ts
+++ b/src/renderer/src/cards/cardPresentation.ts
@@ -133 +133,6 @@ export function useCardPresentation(
-      held.waiting = !current.ready && (replacement || held.waiting || held.entry === null);
+      // Only a card the captain already sees holds its rectangle while the
+      // next one gets ready. An entry on an empty stage is unseen until it
+      // is ready, so it lays out at its natural height meanwhile: its body
+      // frame, clipped by a held rectangle, would report no drawing, and the
+      // record would only appear after the hold ran out (INF-510).
+      held.waiting = !current.ready && (replacement || held.waiting);
diff --git a/src/renderer/src/cards/stageSlots.test.ts b/src/renderer/src/cards/stageSlots.test.ts
index 20609a74..60776e03 100644
--- a/src/renderer/src/cards/stageSlots.test.ts
+++ b/src/renderer/src/cards/stageSlots.test.ts
@@ -114,0 +115,12 @@ describe("stage slots", () => {
+  it("keeps a waiting entry unseen on an empty stage until it is ready (INF-510)", () => {
+    // A task record's facts and body frame arrive in turn: it must not appear
+    // as an empty card that grows twice.
+    const opened = selectSlots(emptySlots<View>(), "record", null, undefined, true);
+    expect(opened.revealed).toBe(false);
+    expect(roles(opened)).toEqual([{ id: "record", role: "shown" }]);
+    expect(revealSlot(opened, keyOf(opened, "record")).revealed).toBe(true);
+    expect(expireSlot(opened, keyOf(opened, "record")).revealed).toBe(true);
+    // Anything else still appears at once.
+    expect(selectSlots(emptySlots<View>(), "card", null, undefined, false).revealed).toBe(true);
+  });
+
